incidents.summary: AWS CloudWatch raised a warning for increased 4xx client errors on the EMEA production Place-Search translations/public endpoint, indicating client request issues or recent config/deploy changes may be causing validation, authorization, or routing failures. Impact currently noted for Location Services (global).

resolutionSuggestions.suggestion: Break down 4xx errors by status code and route to pinpoint the source: analyze CloudWatch metrics and access logs for translations/public, segment by 400/401/403/404/429, and identify top offending clients, user agents, and paths.
Verify recent deployments and configuration changes in EMEA (service, API Gateway/ALB routes, WAF rules); if a spike aligns with a change, roll back or hotfix and re-run canaries.

Check authentication/authorization paths if 401/403 increased: validate IAM policies, authorizers (Cognito/OAuth/JWT), and ensure the translations/public endpoint hasn’t inadvertently been gated by new auth or WAF rules.

Inspect request validation and schema handling at the application layer: confirm supported locales, required query parameters, and input formats; improve validation and return informative errors to clients, and adjust server-side defaults where safe.
Assess routing and mapping templates: ensure API Gateway/ALB routing to translations/public is correct, no recent stage variable/mapping/template changes are causing 404s or misrouted requests.
Evaluate rate limiting and throttling if 429s are present: adjust API Gateway/ALB limits, coordinate client-side retry/backoff, and consider per-tenant quotas or caching for high-frequency queries.

Review WAF/edge configurations for false positives: look for new or tightened rules blocking legitimate requests (e.g., locale parameters, query patterns), and whitelist known-good patterns or clients as needed.
Set up targeted synthetic checks and dashboards for translations/public across common locales and inputs; create alarms per 4xx code to detect regressions early.

Engage top client integrators: share observed error patterns, provide request guidelines, and coordinate test cases; consider temporary feature flags or fallbacks (e.g., default locale) where appropriate and safe.

incidents.summary: Customer’s ID7/HU_MGU navigation shows German gas stations without prices when searching along the route near 49.20378, 8.59601 on 2026-08-29, while fuel prices display normally for France and Spain, indicating a Germany-specific fuel price data or entitlement issue rather than connectivity or hardware.

resolutionSuggestions.suggestion: Verify the DE fuel price provider/feed status (EMEA PROD) around 2026-08-29 13:34 UTC; check backend health dashboards and logs for Germany-only fuel price services (e.g., TPEG/POI price feed) to confirm a regional data outage or suppression.

Re-provision ConnectedDrive entitlements for fuel price display (Germany) for the VIN and push a service refresh to the head unit; after backend refresh, ask the customer to toggle Data Privacy/Online Services off/on to force token renewal and data reload.

Confirm that any market-specific legal/consent requirements for displaying fuel prices in Germany are accepted; if applicable, re-prompt the customer to accept fuel price terms and conditions in the HMI or via their ConnectedDrive account and then retry.

Check HMI filters and fuel type selection: clear all filters (show all fuels), test both the Thematic Map ‘Gas stations’ and the POI list via Online Search (at location vs along route); if list view shows prices but the thematic overlay doesn’t, log a UI/overlay defect for ID7.

Ensure the head unit is on the latest available software and online map components; if there is a known defect affecting German fuel prices on iStep 23-11-550, plan an update to the corrective iStep or deploy the relevant online component fix, then retest.

If a backend/provider issue is confirmed, communicate outage scope and ETA to the customer and offer a temporary workaround (e.g., using the BMW app or an external app to view DE fuel prices) until the feed is restored.
